phase_0.boundary_condition: The metastable folded conformation seals the protein structure and prevents equilibration without extraordinary perturbation.

⊢.justification: no residue contact exists before the chain is initialized

⊣.justification: the closed conformation contains the entire fold and resists spontaneous equilibration

≻.justification: directed transformation builds native contacts from the N terminus toward the C terminus

≺.justification: reverse descent unwinds a misfolded contact to return to a decision point

⋈.justification: each residue crossing composes sequentially with the next to extend the braid word

⊙.justification: the strand recognizes its own topology at the fixed point where μ∘δ = id

∈.justification: one chain state opens into a native-contact arm and a non-native-contact arm

∋.justification: the two carried alternatives rejoin into a single contact topology

⊤.justification: constructive truth verifies a correct residue pairing

⊥.justification: constructive falsity rejects an invalid residue pairing

⊞.justification: native and non-native registers are held simultaneously without resolution

⊡.justification: permanent append-only covalent fixation cannot be undone

phase_2.fuse_result: merged contact topology when the arms agree, conflicting contact registers when they conflict
phase_2.failure_reason: FFUSE3 at step 9 has no FSPLIT3 to pair — ill-typed

phase_3.void_description: empty residue register before any contact is named
phase_3.true_description: native contact affirmed as constructive truth
phase_3.false_description: non-native contact refuted as constructive falsity
phase_3.both_description: native and non-native contact held simultaneously as a live contradiction

steps.domain_action: clear the residue register to the empty state before any contact is named
propagate constraints from the N terminus toward the C terminus as a directed forward morphism
compose each residue crossing with the previous crossing to build the braid word
assert self-reference at the critical fixed point where the strand recognizes itself
open the folding decision at a branching residue into a native-contact arm and a non-native-contact arm
affirm a native contact on the productive arm as constructive truth
refute a steric clash on the trap arm as constructive falsity
hold native and non-native registers simultaneously when the arms conflict
rejoin the carried alternatives into a merged contact topology
reverse contact direction from a misfolded intermediate back to the decision point
chain the reversal step with the forward extension to close the braid loop
anchor the metastable folded conformation as the terminal boundary containing the system
fix the disulfide lock as a permanent append-only record
affirm global constraint propagation across the entire protein structure
refute equilibration to the ground state without extraordinary perturbation
hold metastability and ground-state inaccessibility as a live contradiction
reconstitute the winding invariant from the split arms
record the winding number as an irreversible topological state
